name: asm-lens
description: See the assembly of every function right in the editor: instruction counts as CodeLens, two-way source/assembly highlighting, headers and templates. Uses Compiler Explorer or your local compiler. C, C++, Rust, Go, Python, Zig, Swift, D and Fortran.

enumDescriptions: Compile on Compiler Explorer (asmLens.baseUrl). Your file and the local headers it includes are sent there.
Compile on this machine with your own compiler. Nothing leaves the machine.
asmLens.mode.description: Where code is compiled. A project's .asm-lens.json "mode" overrides this.

asmLens.localCompiler.description: C/C++ compiler for local mode (a GCC- or Clang-compatible command or path, e.g. g++, clang++, /usr/bin/g++-14). Empty means g++. Other languages use their own compiler (rustc, go, python3, swiftc, zig, gfortran).

asmLens.compileCommands.description: Local mode: compile_commands.json database(s) of your build, relative to the workspace folder (e.g. build/compile_commands.json). Used when .asm-lens.json has no "compileCommands".

enumDescriptions: Analyze again in the background when you pause typing (and when you save). Results below an edit stay visible meanwhile.
Only when you ask (CodeLens or command).
asmLens.reanalyzeOn.description: When a file that was analyzed (or a header an analyzed file uses) changes, analyze it again. The whole file is recompiled, since a change can affect every function that inlines the edited one.

asmLens.reanalyzeDelayMs.description: With "asmLens.reanalyzeOn": "edit", how long typing must pause before analyzing again.

asmLens.compilerId.description: Compiler Explorer compiler ID for C/C++, for example g152 or clang1910. Use "Asm Lens: Select Compiler" to browse.

asmLens.compilerName.description: Label for asmLens.compilerId in the status bar and CodeLens. Empty: the compiler id. Select Compiler fills it in.

asmLens.flags.description: Compiler flags sent to Compiler Explorer.

asmLens.language.description: Language sent to Compiler Explorer for C-family files when there is no .asm-lens.json.

asmLens.confirmRemoteUpload.description: Ask before sending your code to a Compiler Explorer server for the first time. Choosing "Don't Show Again" in that dialog applies to that server only; turning this setting off stops asking for every server.

asmLens.requestTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for one compile, in milliseconds (Compiler Explorer, or a local compiler). A Compiler Explorer server that does not answer in time is asked once more.

asmLens.showCounts.description: Show instruction counts as CodeLens above functions.

asmLens.includePaths.description: Extra local include directories (like -I), relative to the workspace folder or absolute. The analyzed file's directory and workspace folders are always searched.

asmLens.highlightOnHover.description: Highlight matching assembly instructions when hovering or moving the cursor over a source line, and the matching source line when hovering an instruction.

asmLens.colorizeLines.description: Color each source line and its assembly instructions with the same color, like Compiler Explorer.

asmLens.autoInstantiateTemplates.description: C++: compile templates without being asked, so that they show code at once: with the types the code uses (Box<int> in the file or in a file including it), otherwise int (or 1 for a number). A template that does not compile with those types asks for them when clicked.

asmLens.emitUnusedFunctions.description: C/C++: also show functions the compiler leaves out when nothing in the file calls them (functions defined inside a class, inline, static and constexpr ones). They are marked __attribute__((used)) (MSVC: their address is taken) before compiling; the file on disk is not changed. Headers analyzed on their own always do this.

asmLens.dimOtherLines.description: While an instruction is hovered, also fade the other lines of its function in the editor and the other instructions in the assembly view. Off: only the matching lines are highlighted and the rest stays as it is.

asmLens.maxIncludeFiles.description: Maximum number of local header files uploaded to Compiler Explorer per analysis.

asmLens.skipFailingFunctions.description: When the code has compile errors (for example a function uses a header that could not be found), leave those functions out and still analyze the rest. Skipped functions show 'Not compiled' in their CodeLens.

asmLens.maxRecoveryAttempts.description: Maximum number of compile requests per analysis while recovering from missing headers and failing functions.

asmLens.followCursor.description: When the assembly view is open, switch it to the function under the cursor.

asmLens.stubFailingHeaders.description: Remote mode: replace an uploaded header that fails in the preprocessor (#error, malformed #if) by an empty file and keep going. Off by default because it can hide a missing define.
